name: Kyuukyoku Seigi Sexy Marble
original_name: 究極正義セクシーマーブル
source:
Our girl Marble and another guy are special people created by a scientist. They are also the only defense against a group of people trying to take over the world. With enough special energy from her guy, Sexy Marble will stop the evil group.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
我们的女孩马波和另一个男人是由科学家创造的特殊人物。它们也是对抗一群试图统治世界的人的唯一防御。凭借她的男人足够的特殊能量，性感大理石将阻止邪恶组织。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
